1.consolidated_definition: Pez marino de hasta 30 cm de longitud, de cuerpo ovalado cubierto de escamas rojizas, aleta dorsal gruesa con espinas fuertes en forma de arco y cola vertical en forma de . (Holocentridae, Holocentrus ascensionis).
1.en_consolidated_definition: Marine fish reaching up to 30 cm in length, with an oval body covered in reddish scales, a thick dorsal fin with strong arc-shaped spines and a vertical tail fin (family Holocentridae, species Holocentrus ascensionis).

2.consolidated_definition: Semilla de algarroba a la que los muchachos le hacen un barreno, le pasan un cordón y juegan golpeándolos unos contra otros.
2.en_consolidated_definition: Seed of carob to which boys make a hole, pass a cord through it, and play by hitting them against each other.

3.en_consolidated_definition: A young man who excessively considers himself physically attractive.

5.consolidated_definition: Remolino de pelo que se forma en la cabeza de una persona.
5.en_consolidated_definition: Turbulence of hair that forms on the head of a person.
